# Flocka Tattoo

> Flocka Tattoo is the portfolio and contact site of tattoo artist Sascha Schlüter in Cologne, Germany.

## Official information

- Brand: Flocka Tattoo
- Artist: Sascha Schlüter
- Artist name: Flocka
- Location: Köln, Deutschland
- Profession: Tattoo artist / Tätowierer
- Availability: Dienstag bis Sonntag, 10:00–19:00 Uhr
- Contact: mailto:flockatattoo@proton.me

## Focus

Flocka creates individual tattoos with clear lines, strong symbols and expressive compositions. The work includes Blackwork, Fine Line, Schwarz-Rot, selected colour work, Ornamentik, Flash tattoos and considered cover-ups.
